    have h_sum : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
        (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) posSites ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) negSites => SU N)).symm
      ((Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) posSites) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K).prod
        (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K))
      (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) posSites ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) =>
        MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K) := by
      exact measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi_symm (fun _ => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K)
    have h_congr : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A => SU N)
        (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hPN).symm)
      (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) posSites ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) =>
        MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K)
      (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K) := by
      simpa [Function.comp] using
        measurePreserving_piCongrLeft (fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A) =>
          MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K) (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hPN).symm
    -- Compose: the trans of MeasurableEquiv corresponds to comp of MeasurePreserving
    have h_comp : MeasurePreserving
      (((MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
        (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) posSites ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) negSites => SU N)).symm).trans
      (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A => SU N)
        (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hPN).symm))
      ((Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) posSites) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K).prod
        (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K))
      (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K) :=
      h_congr.comp h_sum
    -- Rewrite the measures from productHaarMeasure to Measure.pi
    simpa [hprod_eq] using h_comp
  -- Step 2: C(A) × C(intSites) ≃ᵐ C(All) (for A, intSites disjoint)
  have hf2_mp : MeasurePreserving
    (((MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
      (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) intSites => SU N)).symm).trans
    (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) All => SU N)
      (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hAI).symm))
    ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) A).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites))
    (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) All) := by
    -- Same argument as hf1_mp
    have h_sum : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
        (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) intSites => SU N)).symm
      ((Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K).prod
        (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K))
      (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) =>
        MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K) := by
      exact measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi_symm (fun _ => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K)
    have h_congr : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) All => SU N)
        (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hAI).symm)
      (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) =>
        MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K)
      (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) All) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K) := by
      simpa [Function.comp] using
        measurePreserving_piCongrLeft (fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) All) =>
          MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K) (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hAI).symm
    have h_comp : MeasurePreserving
      (((MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
        (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) intSites => SU N)).symm).trans
      (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) All => SU N)
        (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hAI).symm))
      ((Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K).prod
        (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K))
      (Measure.pi fun (_ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) All) => MeasureTheory.Measure.haarMeasure K) :=
      h_congr.comp h_sum
    simpa [hprod_eq] using h_comp
  -- Step 3: C(posSites) × C(negSites) × C(intSites) ≃ C(A) × C(intSites) ≃ C(All) via prodAssoc
  let f1 : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites × FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) ≃ᵐ
      FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) A :=
    ((MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
      (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) posSites ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) negSites => SU N)).symm).trans
    (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A => SU N)
      (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hPN).symm)
  let f2 : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) A × FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) ≃ᵐ
      FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) All :=
    ((MeasurableEquiv.sumPiEquivProdPi
      (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) A ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) intSites => SU N)).symm).trans
    (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) All => SU N)
      (finiteLinkIndexUnionSum hAI).symm)
  let e : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites × FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites ×
      FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) ≃ᵐ FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) All :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc (α := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites)
      (β := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)
      (γ := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)).symm.trans
    ((f1.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites))).trans f2)
  have he_mp : MeasurePreserving e
      ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod
        ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)))
      (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) All) := by
    -- The composition of measure-preserving maps
    have h_assoc_mp : MeasurePreserving
      (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc (α := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites)
        (β := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)
        (γ := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)).symm
      ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod
        ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)))
      (((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)).prod
        (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)) := by
      haveI : SFinite (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) := by
        have h_fin : IsFiniteMeasure (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) :=
          productHaarMeasure_isFiniteMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites
        infer_instance
      haveI : SFinite (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) := by
        have h_fin : IsFiniteMeasure (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) :=
          productHaarMeasure_isFiniteMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites
        infer_instance
      have h_forward : MeasurePreserving
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc (α := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites)
          (β := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)
          (γ := FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites))
        (((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)).prod
          (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites))
        ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod
          ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites))) :=
        measurePreserving_prodAssoc (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites)
          (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)
      exact h_forward.symm
    have h_f1I_mp : MeasurePreserving
      (f1.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)))
      (((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)).prod
        (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites))
      ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) A).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)) := by
      -- f1.prodCongr (refl _) is the same as Prod.map f1 id as a function
      have h_eq : (f1.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl _ : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) ≃ᵐ _)) =
          (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr f1 (MeasurableEquiv.refl _)) := rfl
      -- Use the map_prod_map lemma to show measure preservation
      have h_id_mp : MeasurePreserving (id : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites → _)
          (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) :=
        ⟨measurable_id, by
          simpa using Measure.map_id (μ := productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)⟩
      haveI : SFinite ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod
          (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)) := by
        haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites) :=
          productHaarMeasure_isFiniteMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites
        haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites) :=
          productHaarMeasure_isFiniteMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites
        infer_instance
      haveI : SFinite (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) := by
        have h_fin : IsFiniteMeasure (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) :=
          productHaarMeasure_isFiniteMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites
        infer_instance
      have h_map_prod := Measure.map_prod_map
        ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites))
        (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)
        hf1_mp.measurable measurable_id
      -- h_map_prod: (map f1 μa).prod (map id μc) = map (Prod.map f1 id) (μa.prod μc)
      have h_id_meas : Measurable (id : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites → FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) := measurable_id
      have h_meas : Measurable (Prod.map f1 id) :=
        hf1_mp.measurable.prodMap h_id_meas
      have h_map_eq : Measure.map (Prod.map f1 id)
          (((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)).prod
            (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)) =
          (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) A).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) := by
        calc
          Measure.map (Prod.map f1 id)
              (((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites)).prod
                (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites))
            = (Measure.map f1 ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) posSites).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) negSites))).prod
                (Measure.map id (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)) := by
              symm; exact h_map_prod
        _ = (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) A).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites) := by
          rw [hf1_mp.map_eq, Measure.map_id]
      -- Convert Prod.map f1 id (a function) to the MeasurableEquiv version
      have h_equiv : (f1.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites)) : _ → _) =
          (Prod.map f1 id) := by
        apply funext; intro x; rfl
      rw [h_equiv]
      exact ⟨h_meas, h_map_eq⟩
    have h_f2_mp : MeasurePreserving f2
      ((productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) A).prod (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) intSites))
      (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) All) := hf2_mp
    -- Compose: e = prodAssoc.symm ∘ (f1 × id) ∘ f2
    exact h_f2_mp.comp (h_f1I_mp.comp h_assoc_mp)
  -- Clean up: replace local definitions with the original ones
  dsimp [posSites, negSites, intSites, A] at e he_mp
  dsimp [haarMeasurePositive, haarMeasureNegative, haarMeasureInterface]
  -- Use hAll_eq (All = Finset.univ) to rewrite the goal and finish
  rw [← hAll_eq]
  exact ⟨e, he_mp⟩

/-- The configuration space for positive and interface links together. -/
abbrev PosInterfaceConfig :=
  FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L)

/-- Restriction of a full configuration to the positive and interface links. -/
noncomputable def restrictPosInterface (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
  λ idx => cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ (idx.1.1)⟩

/-- Merging a positive configuration and an interface configuration. -/
noncomputable def mergePosInterface
    (U_plus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L))
    (U_zero : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
  λ idx =>
    match idx with
    | ⟨(n, μ), hmem⟩ =>
      if h : n ∈ positiveSites T L then
        U_plus ⟨(n, μ), h⟩
      else
        have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
          rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hmem with (hpos | hint)
          · exact (h hpos).elim
          · exact hint
        U_zero ⟨(n, μ), hint⟩

/-- The product Haar measure on the positive+interface configuration space. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasurePosInterface : Measure (PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :=
  Measure.map (Function.uncurry (mergePosInterface N T L))
    ((haarMeasurePositive N T L).prod (haarMeasureInterface N T L))

lemma haarMeasurePosInterface_eq :
    haarMeasurePosInterface N T L =
    Measure.map (Function.uncurry (mergePosInterface N T L))
      ((haarMeasurePositive N T L).prod (haarMeasureInterface N T L)) := rfl

/-- Merge a negative and a positive+interface configuration into a full config. -/
noncomputable def mergeConfigurations
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) :=
  λ idx =>
    match idx with
    | ⟨(n, μ), hn⟩ =>
      if hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L then
        U_plus_zero ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_left (interfaceSites T L) hpos⟩
      else if hneg : n ∈ negativeSites T L then
        U_minus ⟨(n, μ), hneg⟩
      else
        have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
          have h_cover : (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) = Finset.univ := by
            ext n'; simp [positiveSites, negativeSites, interfaceSites]
            by_cases hpos' : signedTime T n'.time > 0
            · simp [hpos']
            · by_cases hneg' : signedTime T n'.time < 0
              · simp [hpos', hneg']
              · have hzero' : signedTime T n'.time = 0 := by
                  have hle' : signedTime T n'.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
                  have hge' : signedTime T n'.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
                  linarith
                simp [hpos', hneg', hzero']
          have hn_univ : n ∈ Finset.univ := hn
          have h_mem : n ∈ (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) := by
            rw [h_cover]; exact hn_univ
          rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h_mem with (h | h)
          · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h with (h' | h')
            · exfalso; exact hpos h'
            · exfalso; exact hneg h'
          · exact h
        U_plus_zero ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_right (positiveSites T L) hint⟩

/-- Extend a configuration to a full link variable. -/
noncomputable def extendToFullConfig
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) :=
  extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))
    (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero)

/-- The transfer matrix T acting on functions of the positive+interface configuration. -/
noncomputable def transferMatrix (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ :=
  λ (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) =>
    ∫ (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
      ψ (restrictPosInterface N T L (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero)) *
      Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β
        (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus U_plus_zero))
    ∂ haarMeasureNegative N T L

/-
### Key Identity
-/

/-- The function G = f · exp(-β·S_OS⁺) · exp(-β·S_OS_int/2). -/
noncomputable def G (N T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] (hT : Odd T) (β : ℝ)
    (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ) (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) : ℝ :=
  f U * Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSPositive N T L β U) *
  Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β U / 2)

/-- The restriction of G to the positive+interface configuration space. -/
noncomputable def G_plus (N T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] (hT : Odd T) (β : ℝ)
    (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ) (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) : ℝ :=
  G N T L hT β f (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L) cfg)

lemma transferMatrix_identity (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ) :
    (∫ (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
      G N T L hT β f (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg) *
      G N T L hT β f (reflectLinkVariable N (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg))
      ∂ productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) =
    (∫ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      G_plus N T L hT β f cfg * (transferMatrix N T L β (G_plus N T L hT β f) cfg)
      ∂ haarMeasurePosInterface N T L) := by
  sorry

/-- The interface Boltzmann kernel. -/
noncomputable def interfaceKernel
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L)
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β
    (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus U_plus_zero))

/-- `restrictPosInterface` after `mergeConfigurations` recovers the original positive+interface config. -/
lemma restrict_merge_id (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    restrictPosInterface N T L (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero) = U_plus_zero := by
  ext x
  have hx_type : x.1.1 ∈ positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L := x.2
  -- Work with the underlying pair
  let n := x.1.1
  let μ := x.1.2
  have hmem : n ∈ positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L := hx_type
  -- Unfold definitions enough to see the conditional
  dsimp [restrictPosInterface, mergeConfigurations]
  -- Now compare the two sides by cases on n
  by_cases hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L
  · -- n in positiveSites: both sides use U_plus_zero
    simp [hpos, hmem]
  · -- n not in positiveSites: either negative or interface
    have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hmem with (hpos' | hint')
      · exact (hpos hpos').elim
      · exact hint'
    simp [hpos, hint, hmem]

/-- The transfer matrix T is positive: ⟨ψ, Tψ⟩ ≥ 0 for all ψ. -/
lemma transferMatrix_positive (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (∫ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      ψ cfg * (transferMatrix N T L β ψ) cfg
      ∂ haarMeasurePosInterface N T L) := by
  -- The transfer matrix acts as multiplication by a positive kernel because
  -- `restrictPosInterface ∘ mergeConfigurations` is the identity on PosInterfaceConfig.
  -- Concretely:
  --   (Tψ)(cfg) = ψ(cfg) · ∫ exp(-β·S_OS_int(extendToFullConfig(U_minus, cfg))) dμ⁻(U_minus)
  have h_factor : ∀ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      (transferMatrix N T L β ψ) cfg = ψ cfg *
        (∫ (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
          Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus cfg))
          ∂ haarMeasureNegative N T L) := by
    intro cfg
    dsimp [transferMatrix]
    have h_simp : (λ (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) =>
      ψ (restrictPosInterface N T L (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus cfg)) *
      Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus cfg))) =
      (λ (U_minus : _) => ψ cfg *
        Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus cfg))) := by
      ext U_minus
      simp [restrict_merge_id N T L U_minus cfg]
    rw [h_simp, integral_const_mul]
  have h_nonneg_kernel : ∀ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      0 ≤ ∫ (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
        Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus cfg))
        ∂ haarMeasureNegative N T L := by
    intro cfg
    refine integral_nonneg (λ U_minus => ?_)
    exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus cfg)))
  -- Now integrand = ψ(cfg) * (Tψ)(cfg) = ψ(cfg)² * kernel(cfg), which is pointwise ≥ 0
  refine integral_nonneg (λ cfg => ?_)
  rw [h_factor cfg, mul_assoc]
  have h_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ ψ cfg * ψ cfg := mul_self_nonneg (ψ cfg)
  have h_kernel_nonneg := h_nonneg_kernel cfg
  exact mul_nonneg h_sq_nonneg h_kernel_nonneg

/-- ∫ G(U)·G(θU) dμ₀(U) ≥ 0. -/
lemma integral_G_thetaG_nonneg (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (∫ (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
      G N T L hT β f (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg) *
      G N T L hT β f (reflectLinkVariable N (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg))
